GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was inconvenienced and lost ground. When questioned, rdr stated the gelding was not entirely comfortable in the ground and required pressure from the 1000m to regain contact. He added the gelding did not feel comfortable in its action until balancing up passing the 600m, before running home satisfactorily. Co-tnr confirmed the comments and advised the gelding, first up, would continue its preparation and be stepped up in distance. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.
